name: W4 — Webhook to model to stored result

nodes.name: Webhook (header token)
nodes.notes: Local mode only. Public webhooks are not in v1. Caddy bounds the body to 1 MB before this node ever runs, so an unauthenticated POST costs nothing.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'local-chat', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.body.prompt }], max_tokens: 256 }) }}

nodes.name: Ask the model via LiteLLM
nodes.notes: LiteLLM is the ONLY inference front door. n8n cannot reach Ollama directly — they share no network — and that is the point.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO w4_results (prompt, answer, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, now())

nodes.name: Store the result
nodes.notes: Uses the n8n role, which is not a superuser and can only reach its own database.
